lines: A former member of the UFS Navy Special Forces and a cyborg now belonging to secret service agency "G," an agency afﬁliated with the UFS state department.
Muscles reinforced with metal fibers, and powerful enough to beat an Ogre to death bare-handed.
Using the specially made bat on top of that, even an Ogre's skull would be pulverized, never mind what would happen to a human womanー
With a final blow, Saika's head exploded and she crumbled to the floor, blood spouting from her neck.
In its death throes, Saika's headless body twitched and jerked.
Seize? Me? Someone as weak as you? What a joke!
Next up, the head of Tokiko, whose limbs had been crushed and rendered unusable, was smashed to pieces by the specially made bat.
The only one left now was the cocky kid who was shaking in his boots behind Tokiko and Saika.
Ahaha!! Both you and those gals... stop making me laugh!
Aiming for the head, Major swung her metal bat.
Damn... she's much heavier than she looks.
That's because she's a cyborg. Just a bit further, Master.
Hmph... how did you like that...?
I could hear Major mumbling to herself. I was carrying her limp and hollow-eyed body on my back, having returned to the academy.
Do your best, Young Lord. My Evil Eye is active, so...
Saika, too, was hanging listlessly on Tokiko's back.
Her eyes were not taking in our surroundings. They were hacking into Major's vision and consciousness and showing her an alternate reality.

That was the power of Saika's Evil Eyeー
the power to hijack the vision and consciousness of those who looked into her eyes.
However, she had to concentrate as well and could hardly fight while it was in use, leaving her defenseless.
Sheesh. I didn't expect it to turn out like this.
I, too, was impressed, Young Lord... no, Master.
Stop it... Being called Master by you, Saika, is a bit...

It felt weird because it made me think of my fatherー
but I swallowed those words.
Ehehe, understood. I will keep calling you Young Lord then.
Also, it kinda ended up like this, but about the chocolate...
Rest assured. My chocolate is always yours, Young Lord.
I was so happy that I almost dropped Major.
You don't mind, do you, Tokiko?
Eh!? N-No, I don't really mind, but... um, Master!? You mustn't get too excited!
Chocolate might not even be enough... Ah, I know, when we get home, I will wash your back, Young Lord.
Saika!? Master is not a child anymore.
Now, now, Tokiko, don't be so jealous♪ Ah, how about you give him a massage then?
Nice. Tokiko's massages are the best.
Master. The Fuma Saika plan seems to have failed.
...It's just as well. I didn't really expect it to work anyway.
Fuma Saika, a powerful Evil Eye user and Danjo's former secretary.
Luring her to his side would not only have increased his combat capabilities, but it would have also provided legitimacy to his claim as the successor of the Fuma Clan.
With that in mind, he had sent someone in secret to try and persuade her, but Saika had flatly refused.
I think it was a good idea to spread information to "G" to have them to take care of it if possible.
It seemed that "G," who used to work with Danjo in the past, had also long wanted to capture Saika, who still possessed intel.
So Gaiza and his men had spread information about Saika's current whereabouts to "G," and an assassin had been sent just as they had hoped, butー
It's painful that Fuma Saika, one of the most powerful members of the Fuma Clan, has sided with the young lord of the head family.
It would almost be boring otherwise. I'll deal with that guy myself eventually.
As Gaiza spoke, it appeared as though his next battle plan was already taking form in the back of his mind.
